aliases: 2K Battery Wi-Fi Smart Dual-Powered Video Doorbell

power.method: dual power: existing doorbell wiring or built-in rechargeable battery

features: dual power: hardwired or rechargeable battery
AI human and vehicle detection alerts
local microSD, cloud, or Night Owl recorder storage
release_notes: Night Owl H4DB: a 2K (4MP) dual-powered Wi-Fi smart video doorbell with a 150 degree ultra-wide view, human/vehicle detection, two-way audio and microSD/cloud/recorder storage; runs hardwired or on its built-in battery. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted.

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).
